remarks: Located just minutes from downtown Stamford, the train station, and I-95, this stylish and pet-friendly 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath end unit offers convenience, comfort, and thoughtful updates. The main level features new vinyl flooring and an open-concept living and dining area that leads to a private exterior deck through sliding glass doors-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen has been tastefully updated with stainless steel appliances and modern finishes. Upstairs, you'll find two well-proportioned bedrooms with double closets, and an updated full bath, while the main level includes a powder room and a large coat/storage closet for added functionality. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, an assigned parking space (#18) conveniently located near the unit, a community room, and a separate storage area. Situated near Glenbrook Village shopping, this home combines suburban tranquility with city accessibility.
